latest_release.body:
Falcon 4.4.0 contains a handful of long-requested features – a [`RegexConverter`](https://falcon.readthedocs.io/en/4.4.0/api/routing.html#falcon.routing.RegexConverter) field converter, an application-wide [error reporter](https://falcon.readthedocs.io/en/4.4.0/api/app.html#falcon.App.set_error_reporter), and a new `allow_multiple` keyword argument for the query string parameter helpers, along with a number of bug fixes. As usual, the newest CPython runtime, 3.15, is fully supported (including [binary wheels](https://falcon.readthedocs.io/en/4.4.0/user/install.html#binary-wheels)).

🐍 [Falcon 4.4.0 on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/falcon/4.4.0/)
📚 [Changelog on RtD](https://falcon.readthedocs.io/en/4.4.0/changes/4.4.0.html)

The error reporter also serves as groundwork for the native OpenTelemetry integration that has been on our roadmap for a while. We are hoping to ship that integration as part of [Falcon 4.5](https://github.com/falconry/falcon/milestone/48).

This release would not have been possible without the prototypes, fixes, and feature pull requests submitted by our community. Sincere thanks to our supporters and contributors!
